digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill Step 7 and plan-review documentation
propositions: Step 7 (sibling sweep) lacks a class-level design-review gate that turns confirmed siblings into declared scope checkboxes on the bug ticket before Phase 2 proceeds

Confirmed sibling sets must be recorded via set-file-impact and routed through review-plan to trigger the existing bug_blast_radius_escalates escalation out of the light advisory tier into full blocking review

Step 7 must reference and link to the existing Phase-1 exit-gate directive (SKILL.md:562-568) rather than restating it, and remain portable by gating rebar command names on tracker type with generic equivalents

docs/plan-review-gate.md contradicts the shipped blast-radius escalation at two passages (486-490 and 1348-1353) claiming bugs are never blocked, requiring a new subsection under R4 and corrections to those passages to name the escalation exception
